protocolRefs.multiCallChain: DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

overloadMerges.note: parentElemName and parentElemValue are out-parameters that the command fills in with the parent element's name/value, not inputs; the mechanical draft parsed them as direction 'in' like elementRef.

params.name: parentElemName
params.description: Receives the name of the parent element

params.name: parentElemValue
params.description: Receives the value of the parent element

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns a reference to the parent XML element (or the "#document" reference if elementRef is a root element), optionally filling in the parent's name and value.

constraints: If elementRef is already the document node, the command returns a null reference ("0000000000000000") and sets OK to 0.
